names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιοι Ευάγριος και Σίος εκ Γεωργίας», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

feast.note: The life page saint.gr gives for this line carries no life at all, only «Βλέπε 4 Ιανουαρίου» — see 4 January — so the Greek calendar appears to keep the pair on that day as well (https://www.saint.gr/1281/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). The day recorded is the day page read.
